## Code failures per prompt and seed

Failed tasks are put into one category, checked in this order: **wrong logic** (the graded code defines the entry point, a test fails: wrong result, error or timeout); **empty at cap** (counted under "No usable code": no code extracted because the answer stopped at the {{cap}}-token limit; an empty solution is graded as a failure, as in EvalPlus and the TaH2 harness); **entry point not defined**; **no usable code** (the rest, e.g. sanitize dropped code it could not parse, or the answer is a script that reads input instead of a function). Percentages are shares of the failures.

## Runs: restarts and throughput

**Throughput** (tok/s) is generated tokens divided by the time the engine spent generating; it excludes model loading and grading.

{{runs_table}}

Some requests were restarted after a host-memory overflow; the restarted samples are complete and valid, and the per-run counts are in the table. \* Seed-42 AMC23 was resumed after an out-of-memory failure. Its first attempt left no telemetry, so the restart count and throughput are incomplete; one unfinished duplicate was dropped ({{merge_note}}).

## Datasets as used

{{datasets_table}}

Hub datasets are pinned by the revision in the local Hugging Face cache that the runs loaded; local files by SHA256. EvalPlus (the code test suite) contributes the extra tests and the grader. One seed of the protocol is {{total_samples}} graded answers.

**Reproduce:** `./reproduce.sh curate` writes `data/datasets.json`.
